# A credit block whose `amount:` is a word rather than a figure.
#
# The block states a real credit through `txn_guid:` and `txn_split_guid:`,
# which the test fills in, so the amount is the only thing wrong with it.
#
# What this fixture produces: nothing. The import refuses the invoice.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_a_credit_block_stating_a_split_it_cannot_spend_is_refused.py.
invoice "INV-CREDIT-WORD"
	customer_id: "C001"
	currency: CAD
	date_opened: 2026-02-01
	entry:
		date: 2026-02-01
		description: "B"
		action: "Hours"
		account: "Income:Sales"
		quantity: 1
		price: 30
		taxable: false
		tax_included: false
	posted:
		date: 2026-02-01
		due: 2026-02-28
		ar_account: "Assets:Accounts Receivable"
		memo: "INV-CREDIT-WORD"
		accumulate: true
	payment:
		amount: thirty
		from_credit: true
		credit_dated: 2026-01-10
		txn_guid: "TXN_GUID"
		txn_split_guid: "SPLIT_GUID"
